name: instruction-placement
description: Routes agent instructions to the surface that loads them at the right time. audit finds conventions narrower than the always-loaded CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md holding them, or stranded in docs Claude never loads, and proposes a destination with a validated paths glob; safety-class content is never demoted. realign applies moves item by item and regenerates an index. check verifies globs and index. migrate moves content to AGENTS.md with a CLAUDE.md shim. setup checks the index is readable.

index_drift_hook_enabled.title: Index-drift hook
index_drift_hook_enabled.description: PostToolUse notice when a write inside a .claude/rules tree leaves the generated index stale. On by default. Advisory and non-blocking; the authoritative gate is /instruction-placement:check in CI. Costs a string comparison on writes outside a rules tree.

breadth_max.title: Over-broad glob ceiling (percent)
breadth_max.description: Percent of tracked files above which a rule's paths: glob is reported over-broad. Default 75. Advisory only, never fails the check gate. Raise it in a repository where one extension legitimately covers most files.

index_max_rows.title: Index rows before grouping
index_max_rows.description: Surfaces listed individually in the generated index before the remainder is grouped by directory with a count. Default 40. The index is always-loaded, so this bounds its own cost.
